_fixture: INTEGRATION/EXAMPLE DOSSIER for NCF1 / p47phox (P14598), a PPI-adaptor with ZERO annotated binding/active site. Produced by a real pipeline run 2026-08-15/16: paperclip (uniprot_v/pdb_v/chembl_v + raw chembl.molecule_dictionary), precedent-lookup/modality.py (RDKit, selftest PASS 0 false small-molecule calls), pocket-scan deployed Modal app 'druggability-pocket-scan' (fpocket 4.2.3 + P2Rank 2.5.1, D swept {1.6,2.4}, mdpocket, disorder, cryptic), and structure-select/neighbour_precedent.py (Foldseek, proto-tools). It is a SNAPSHOT and will go stale when the pipeline changes; re-run rather than trust it. Not a validator/rubric calibration example.
_activation_direction_note: THE THERAPEUTIC HYPOTHESIS IS TO ACTIVATE THE NOX2 OXIDATIVE BURST, NOT INHIBIT IT (NCF1 is genetically validated in RA via the R90H hypofunctional allele; a burst-restoring / activating small molecule is the asset idea). The mechanism_hypothesis enum {orthosteric, allosteric, oligomer_destabilisation, unknown} has NO 'activation' value; 'oligomer_destabilisation' would connote INHIBITION of the assembled oxidase and is actively wrong for an activation hypothesis, so the least-wrong echo is 'unknown'. See not_found. This station reports small-molecule tractability only; genetic validation is another station's axis and does NOT lift the verdict here.

axis_conflict: The two axes point in DIFFERENT directions from the therapeutic hypothesis, and neither carries the verdict FOR THE ASKED MECHANISM (activation). RETRIEVED axis: genuine, recent small-molecule chemistry exists against p47phox — 147 distinct small molecules, a characterised sub-micromolar small-molecule Ki (220 nM, CHEMBL5411448, confidence 9), and a covalent-inhibition assay series — but every bit of it INHIBITS assembly (disrupts the p47phox tandem-SH3 / p22phox interaction, or covalently modifies p47phox), which is the OPPOSITE pharmacology to the activation the asset needs. The single sub-100 nM affinity in the whole set (43 nM Kd, CHEMBL5197024) is a PEPTIDE, not a small molecule (rule 1d), so it is not small-molecule-attributable. Zero approved and zero clinical small molecules act on NCF1 directly (chembl_v.drugs_by_accession = 0 rows). COMPUTED axis: uninterpretable for a site — all 11 PDB entries are apo (no drug-like ligand anywhere; 8WEJ's FAD/NADPH/heme/GTP are endogenous oxidase cofactors on the catalytic subunit), UniProt annotates ZERO Binding site and ZERO Active site on NCF1, and on the autoinhibited tandem-SH3+AIR ensemble (1NG2, 1UEC) pocket selection degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site (rule 4.0: does not identify a site) with the two structures' top pockets 8.85 A apart. The structural-neighbour fold (tandem SH3) has no drug-like holo in any of its 9 neighbour accessions. So the retrieved axis shows the interface is modestly ligandable for INHIBITION while the computed axis finds no anchorable activation pocket — recorded, not resolved. verdict_basis is 'none'.

target_precedent._site_attribution_note: Every figure here is measured on the P14598 accession. The chemistry is a recent (2023-2024, high CHEMBL IDs) campaign of INHIBITORS of NADPH-oxidase assembly: covalent p47phox modifiers and disruptors of the p47phox tandem-SH3 / p22phox(149-162) interaction. It is real small-molecule precedent for INHIBITING the complex; it is NOT precedent for the ACTIVATION hypothesis this dossier is keyed on, and it must not be read as such.

pocket_scan Modal 'druggability-pocket-scan' run 2026-08-16: structures.1NG2/1UEC tier 'apo'.

tractability._primary: READ site_hypothesis_basis FIRST: NO site was established. NCF1 has ZERO annotated Binding site / Active site, there is no drug-like holo anywhere to anchor a site, and no partner complex was supplied to define an activation site. Every geometric number below describes a cavity fpocket found in an apo autoinhibited tandem-SH3 structure; none is a measurement of an activation site, and pocket selection degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site (rule 4.0: does not identify a site).

pocket_volume_a3._primary_note: 245.7 A^3 is the D=1.6 top (by max-druggability) cavity in the single structure 1NG2; 1UEC's is 111.2 A^3 at D=1.6. THESE ARE NOT A SITE VOLUME and are NOT pooled into min/max: site_pocket_selected_by is max_druggability_no_ligand_site (rule 4b: does not identify a site), and the two structures' top pockets sit 8.85 A apart (radius-from-centre 5.79 vs 14.64 A), i.e. they are different cavities. The 210/240 A^3 guide is withdrawn (rule 4a) and is not invoked. Reported per structure, here, not as a spread.

pocket_druggability._comparability: WITHIN ONE STRUCTURE only, and not even reported as a range: min/max are null. site_pocket_selected_by is max_druggability_no_ligand_site — the path rule 4.0 says must never produce a reportable value — so a pooled druggability spread would measure nothing. The per-structure values are modest: 1NG2 D=1.6 top cavity druggability_score 0.224 (fpocket rank 2 of 11, PRANK rank 3). Reported beside its rank in site_pocket_rank, never as a verdict input.
pocket_druggability._provenance: shipped fpocket 4.2.3: a 3-descriptor logistic regression fitted on 21 positives, whose dominant descriptor is min-max normalised over the current structure's own pocket list (pocket.c:736-756). A within-structure rank, not a probability.
pocket_druggability._false_negative_rate: REPORTED, NEVER LOAD-BEARING. Druggability may not carry a negative or insufficient_evidence verdict on its own (rule 4.0). Low druggability on holo crystals with a drug bound is common (e.g. EGFR 6LUD with osimertinib 0.013); the 41% figure once quoted rests on a denominator under audit and a cross-structure pooling this rule forbids — state the direction and named cases, not a percentage. Here druggability contributed nothing to the verdict.
pocket_druggability._do_not_max: max_druggability_no_ligand_site measures pocket count (r(n_pockets, max druggability)=0.702) and is banned as a reportable value. It fired here only because there is no ligand and no site_residues to anchor a site; its output is shown per structure so a reader can see what the banned path produces, not as a finding.

site_pocket_rank._note: Reported for completeness, NOT as a site claim — the ranked pocket was selected by max_druggability_no_ligand_site, which does not identify a site. fpocket rank and PRANK rank are two within-structure orderings; they disagree here (fpocket 2 vs PRANK 3) which is itself only noise on a non-site.

ensemble_consensus_fraction._note: Published criterion (~70% of structures with a strong hot spot) is not evaluable as a tractability signal here — and it is not one anyway (AUC 0.560). Denominators given so the fraction's meaninglessness is visible.

tractability.site_centroid_to_ligand_note: mdpocket ran on the 2-structure ensemble (mdpocket_status 'ok') but returned ONLY a site_from_density (the most persistent cavity), NOT a site_from_ligand — there is no holo donor anywhere in the NCF1 PDB set and no mdpocket_site_donor was supplied, so distance_to_donor_ligand_centroid_a is null (distance_reason: 'no site donor'). Per rule 4b clause 4 this persistent cavity is UNVERIFIED and was NOT adopted as the site; mdpocket_site_definition_used is therefore 'none'.
tractability._annotated_binding_site_overlap_basis: A MEASURED ZERO, not a failed measurement. uniprot_v.features for P14598 contains ZERO 'Binding site' and ZERO 'Active site' features (explicit COUNT FILTER: 0 and 0); the only Ligand keyword is 'Lipid-binding' (the PX domain's phosphoinositide site, not a druggable small-molecule pocket annotation). There is nothing curated to overlap, so overlap is exactly 0. This is the PPI-adaptor signature the prior run flagged, verified.

cryptic_evidence._note: The apo census the cryptic call would rest on. Vajda 2018: cryptic only if the site is absent in all/nearly all unbound structures.
cryptic_evidence.basis: NOT MEASURED, and the null is the finding. pocket_scan cryptic stage returned cryptic_status 'not_run', reason '0 holo reference and 2 apo': crypticity is a pairwise apo-vs-holo measurement and there is no holo NCF1 structure to superpose against. cryptic_pocket_risk is set 'high' on the rule-3 basis that geometric scoring is blind to cryptic sites on an apo-only target, so a low/absent pocket score here is an absence of measurement, not evidence against tractability — NOT because crypticity was demonstrated.
cryptic_evidence.definition: Vajda et al. 2018 / CryptoBench pocket-residue RMSD > 2 A between apo and holo. Named so a reader can see it was NOT applied.

cryptic_potency_prior._note: Mechanism is a prior on achievable potency; none was determined here.
cryptic_potency_prior.basis: No cryptic mechanism was determined (census not run), so no potency prior applies. Reporting a ceiling would be inventing one.

pocket_vs_interface._note: Measured, not assumed — and here not measurable. Requires a complex structure containing the partner relevant to the mechanism.
pocket_vs_interface._why: The interface stage did not run: no partner_structures were supplied. For the ACTIVATION hypothesis the relevant 'interface' is either the intramolecular AIR/tandem-SH3 autoinhibitory contact (an activator would disrupt it to relieve autoinhibition) or the assembled NOX2 complex (8WEJ); neither was passed as a partner complex, and asserting orthosteric/allosteric/destabiliser without one is exactly what this module refuses to do. classification is no_partner_structure; matches_mechanism_hypothesis is false because no pocket found is an activation candidate. Note oligomer_destabilisation would DEstabilise/inhibit the assembly — the opposite of the activation asked for.

tractability.clash_attribution: Not computable — clash attribution needs a holo reference to transfer a ligand from, and there is no holo NCF1 structure (and no drug-like holo in the tandem-SH3 fold neighbourhood either). A null for want of a reference, not a null result.
tractability.caveat: The computed axis measured almost nothing about a SITE, and saying so is the result. Disorder ran (0.2718 over the 390-residue full-length sequence; the single disordered region is 285-390, i.e. exactly the PBR/AIR). fpocket detection ran and found cavities. But: cryptic not_run (needs an apo/holo pair; NCF1 has 0 holo), interface not_run (no partner complex supplied), mdpocket returned only an unanchored site_from_density, and site selection degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site on both apo structures — which does not identify a site — with their top pockets 8.85 A apart. UniProt annotates zero Binding site / Active site on NCF1. So the honest computed reading is: this is a PROTEIN-PROTEIN-INTERACTION ADAPTOR with no orthosteric small-molecule pocket that the geometry can establish, on an apo-only structure set. Chains were asserted (1NG2=A, 1UEC=A) per rule 2b as the autoinhibited tandem-SH3+AIR unit. None of this weighs against the target being ligandable at the p22phox interface — the retrieved axis shows it is, for INHIBITION — it says the ACTIVATION site the asset needs is not established by structure here.

affinity._why_null: Rule 13: no affinity predictor in this deployment, so rule 12's mandatory positive control is unsatisfiable rather than skipped. A characterised control binder exists (CHEMBL5411448, Ki 220 nM small molecule; or the 43 nM peptide CHEMBL5197024) but having a control and no predictor is still no prediction.

checks_run: Do all reported actives trace to one paper/lab/series? PARTIALLY — FOUND. The 147 small molecules cluster into a small number of recent (2023-2024, high CHEMBL IDs) p47phox campaigns: a covalent-inhibition series (top assay, 21.3%) and a p22phox(149-162) SH3-displacement series (19.8%), with several bivalent PEG-linked bis-aminoquinoline/aminonaphthyridine scaffolds among the most potent. This is a narrow, recent chemical space, not decades of independent series; treat the precedent as one-programme-deep.

Is the best potency from a characterised assay, and is it a small molecule? MIXED — FOUND. The single best affinity, Kd 43 nM (CHEMBL5197024), is a PEPTIDE (modality.py: proline/arginine backbone), not small-molecule-attributable (rule 1d). The best SMALL-MOLECULE value is Ki 220 nM (CHEMBL5411448) from a characterised FP competition assay (confidence 9, relation '='). So the headline nanomolar figure evaporates once modality is applied; small molecules top out sub-micromolar, not nanomolar.

Are the actives promiscuous binders / frequent hitters? FOUND for the clinical hits. EBSELEN (max_phase 3 by the rule-2d cross-check) is an organoselenium benzisoselenazol-3-one — a textbook promiscuous redox-active/covalent frequent hitter — at only ~12 uM on p47phox; it is an off-target hit, not an NCF1 lead. More broadly the top assay is 'Covalent inhibition of p47phox', and covalent/PEG-linked bivalent chemistry carries the usual specificity caveats. No PAINS/aggregator database was queried (see not_found), so this is flagged, not adjudicated.

Does the direction of the chemistry match the therapeutic hypothesis? NO — THE CENTRAL FINDING. Every retrieved active INHIBITS assembly (disrupts p47phox-p22phox or covalently modifies p47phox). The hypothesis is to ACTIVATE the burst. An assembly inhibitor is not precedent for an activator; if anything it is anti-precedent for the same interface. The mechanism_hypothesis enum cannot even represent 'activation'.

Is the pocket an artifact of one crystal form / additive? N/A in the damaging direction — there is no holo pocket to be an artifact of; all 11 entries are apo and the only heteroatoms are additives (GOL/SO4/TFA) or oxidase cofactors (8WEJ). CHECK RUN, no holo-pocket artifact possible.

Does the fold carry transferable small-molecule precedent? NO. Foldseek fold neighbours of the tandem SH3 (645 hits, 28 passing, 9 accessions) are all SH3 PPI adaptors (STAC1/2/3, Crk/CRKL, sorbin, Grb2, Ephexin4) and NONE carries a drug-like holo (n_with_holo_single_protein 1, none drug-like). SH3 adaptors are classic hard PPI targets; the fold offers nothing to transfer.

Is the actives count an artifact of a moving row cap / dominant off-target assay (rule 6/14)? NO. distinct compounds reconciled (COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) 149 == 149 unique in the row pull); bioactivities 348 == B 348 + F 0; no assay exceeds 30% and every top assay is on p47phox or its p22phox interaction (measures_a_different_target false). CHECK RUN, nothing found.

Were clinical programmes against NCF1 terminated, and why? NOT RUN — no trials/literature termination search this session (see not_found). Absence of terminated_programs must not be read as 'nobody failed' nor as 'nobody tried'.
findings: Genuine recent small-molecule chemistry exists against p47phox (147 distinct small molecules; best SM Ki 220 nM, characterised), demonstrating the p47phox / p22phox interface is MODESTLY ligandable — but exclusively for INHIBITION of assembly, the opposite direction to the activation hypothesis.
The single sub-100 nM affinity in the set (43 nM Kd) is a PEPTIDE, not a small molecule; small molecules top out sub-micromolar.

Zero approved and zero clinical small molecules act on NCF1 directly (drugs_by_accession 0 rows); the only clinical-phase hits (ebselen, quipazine) are off-target, and ebselen is a promiscuous frequent hitter.

The computed axis establishes no site: NCF1 has zero annotated Binding/Active sites, all 11 PDB entries are apo, and pocket selection degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site with the two apo structures' top pockets 8.85 A apart.
The tandem-SH3 fold has no drug-like holo across 9 Foldseek neighbour accessions — no transferable fold precedent.
Genetic validation (R90H, RA) is target validation, not small-molecule tractability, and does not lift this dossier's verdict.

next_experiment.description: A biophysical (SPR/NMR) or crystallographic/cryo-EM fragment screen aimed specifically at an ACTIVATING modality — small molecules that bind the intramolecular AIR / tandem-SH3 autoinhibitory interface of p47phox and DISRUPT it (relieving autoinhibition to promote NADPH-oxidase assembly and the oxidative burst), read out by a functional burst/assembly assay with a co-structure of any activator bound. The computed axis measured almost nothing about a SITE, and saying so is the result. Disorder ran (0.2718 over the 390-residue full-length sequence; the single disordered region is 285-390, i.e. exactly the PBR/AIR). fpocket detection ran and found cavities. But: cryptic not_run (needs an apo/holo pair; NCF1 has 0 holo), interface not_run (no partner complex supplied), mdpocket returned only an unanchored site_from_density, and site selection degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site on both apo structures — which does not identify a site — with their top pockets 8.85 A apart. UniProt annotates zero Binding site / Active site on NCF1. So the honest computed reading is: this is a PROTEIN-PROTEIN-INTERACTION ADAPTOR with no orthosteric small-molecule pocket that the geometry can establish, on an apo-only structure set. Chains were asserted (1NG2=A, 1UEC=A) per rule 2b as the autoinhibited tandem-SH3+AIR unit. None of this weighs against the target being ligandable at the p22phox interface — the retrieved axis shows it is, for INHIBITION — it says the ACTIVATION site the asset needs is not established by structure here.
Metric metric.disorder_fraction carries no evidence or assumption link.
